summary: Verified Admin SOC Overview + Hybrid Analysis integration end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests PASS in test_soc_and_hybrid.py — /api/admin/overview requires JWT (401), returns full shape with populated iocs.by_severity/by_type and providers.hybrid_analysis=true; /api/threat-intel/overview public and includes hybrid_analysis provider flag; /api/ioc-lookup enriches SHA256 with real HA data (EICAR sha256 returned malicious/verdict/score/url) and returns {skipped:true,reason:'sha256_required'} for MD5; POST /api/hybrid/quick-scan-url returns 422 for invalid URL and 200 with full scanners payload for valid EICAR URL. Frontend: /admin defaults to Overview tab (active border/text color styling), SocDashboard renders with all 4 KPI tiles + 6 panels + refresh; Refresh reloads without unmounting; Reports tab switching from SOC dashboard works. Bulk analyzer /threat-intelligence: MD5+SHA256 pasted — MD5 row shows only VT badge (66/68, HA correctly hidden due to skipped), SHA256 row shows VT (65/67) + Hybrid Analysis (Malicious · 100). No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1956 lines — recommend extracting hybrid_analysis, OTX, and admin/overview aggregation into separate modules for maintainability.
admin_overview issues ~10 sequential count_documents queries; could be reduced with a single $facet aggregation for lower DB round-trip time on larger collections.
IOC lookup response is unauthenticated but performs paid VT + HA API calls — consider rate-limiting or adding auth to prevent abuse of upstream keys.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing OTX-synced IOCs (444) and leads.
